title: Do Machine Learning-Guided Proactive Full Capacity Protocols Mitigate Emergency Department Overcrowding? A Simulation-Based Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Emergency department (ED) overcrowding threatens care quality, yet Full Capacity Protocols (FCPs) are typically activated only after crowding thresholds have been exceeded. This study evaluated whether machine learning-guided proactive FCP activation improves ED crowding control compared with conventional reactive activation.   Materials and Methods: We developed and validated an integrated machine learning and discrete-event simulation framework representing ED patient flow and capacity management. An embedded machine learning model predicted hourly waiting-room crowding six hours ahead and triggered proactive FCP activation. Using empirically calibrated operational parameters from a large US hospital, we compared proactive and reactive deployment strategies over a 365-day simulation horizon with 10 independent replications. Outcomes included ED length of stay, wait time, percentage of time above the crowding threshold, num

translated_title: 机器学习引导的主动式满负荷方案能否缓解急诊科拥挤？一项基于仿真的评估
translated_abstract: 目的：急诊科（ED）拥挤威胁着医疗质量，然而满负荷方案（FCPs）通常仅在拥挤程度超过阈值后才被激活。本研究评估了机器学习引导的主动式满负荷方案激活与传统反应式激活相比，能否改善急诊科的拥挤控制。材料与方法：我们开发并验证了一个集成机器学习与离散事件仿真的框架，用于刻画急诊科患者流与容量管理。其中嵌入的机器学习模型可提前六小时预测候诊室的每小时拥挤情况，并据此触发主动式满负荷方案激活。基于从美国一家大型医院经验校准的运营参数，我们在365天的仿真周期内通过10次独立重复实验，比较了主动式与反应式部署策略。结果指标包括急诊科住院时长、等待时间、超过拥挤阈值的时间百分比等（原文摘要在此截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建了机器学习与离散事件仿真相结合的评估框架，利用提前六小时的候诊室拥挤预测来触发主动式满负荷方案，以检验其相比传统阈值触发式（反应式）激活能否更有效地控制急诊科拥挤。
en_tdlr: This study developed an integrated machine learning and discrete-event simulation framework that uses six-hour-ahead waiting-room crowding predictions to proactively trigger Full Capacity Protocols, evaluating whether this proactive approach controls emergency department overcrowding better than conventional reactive threshold-based activation.
